options.name: --all

arguments.name: alias

acquire-lease

commands.name: essentials
commands.description: Switches to the PostSharp Essentials edition, which is free for everyone.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Lists all registered licenses.

arguments.name: license
arguments.description: The license key or license server URL to be  registered.

commands.name: try
commands.description: Activates the PostSharp Ultimate trial period.

commands.name: unregister

commands.name: news
disable

commands.name: enable
commands.description: Enables automatic notifications for new PostSharp  updates.

commands.name: notify
commands.description: Displays a notification with the latest PostSharp  news.

commands.name: shutdown

options.name: --all
options.description: Also ends the processes that are left running by  default, such as those of integrated development environments.

options.name: --force
options.description: Cancels the work of the processes, and ends the ones  that have not exited when the timeout has elapsed.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: How long to wait for the processes to exit, in  seconds.

commands.description: Stops the processes that keep PostSharp files locked after a build: asks them to exit, waits for them, and reports the ones that remain.  Also available as 'kill'.

commands.name: telemetry
disable

arguments.name: scenario
arguments.description: The kind of telemetry to configure:  'usage', 'exception', 'performance' or  'all'. Defaults to 'all'.

commands.description: Disables telemetry for a scenario (usage, exception,  performance or all).

commands.name: enable

arguments.name: scenario
arguments.description: The kind of telemetry to configure:  'usage', 'exception', 'performance' or  'all'. Defaults to 'all'.

commands.description: Enables telemetry for a scenario (usage, exception,  performance or all).

commands.name: reset

arguments.name: scenario
arguments.description: The kind of telemetry to configure:  'usage', 'exception', 'performance' or  'all'. Defaults to 'all'.

commands.description: Resets telemetry for a scenario (usage, exception,  performance or all) to its default state (review-first for exceptions and  performance problems).

commands.name: reset-dedup
commands.description: Clears the record of already-reported issues so they  are captured again (testing aid).

commands.name: reset-device-id
commands.description: Generates a new anonymous device identifier for  telemetry.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Displays current telemetry configuration and status.

options.name: --async

options.name: --force
options.description: Force the upload even if another upload has been  performed recently.

commands.description: Uploads all queued telemetry data immediately.
